name: Focus
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of maintaining unwavering focus on God’s purposes, as seen in Nehemiah’s dedication to his great work despite distractions. Proverbs encourages believers to keep their eyes fixed straight ahead, symbolizing steady attention and commitment. This focus is rooted in entrusting our efforts to the Lord, which brings stability to our thoughts. Christ calls us to prioritize seeking God’s kingdom and righteousness above all else, navigating the narrow path that leads to life with courage and reliance on His sustaining strength.
